title: Fourier concentration on a large family
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ have positive total influence $I(f)$. For real numbers $\epsilon,\eta>0$ and an integer $k\ge0$, set $\rho=\eta/(2+\eta)$ and $\tau=((\epsilon/I(f))\rho^k)^{1+\eta}$. Let $\mathcal F$ consist of every coordinate set that either is contained in the set of coordinates with pivotal probability at least $\tau$, or has size greater than $k$. The sum of squared Fourier coefficients of $f$ over sets outside $\mathcal F$ is at most $\epsilon$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the sign cube to the signs
The total influence of $f$ is positive
